summary: Trace Sheriff is a dependency-free Bun/TypeScript CLI that streams JSONL agent session logs line by line, reconstructs per-session phase and tool spans (wall clock, summed tool time, peak concurrency, idle gaps, incomplete spans, outcome), and reports 19 anomaly codes including malformed JSON, duplicate event IDs, clock reversals, orphan span ends, open spans, missing or duplicated session boundaries, and overlapping exclusive tools. It prints a readable terminal summary, writes a deterministic JSON report, and generates a self-contained HTML timeline with client-side session/severity/text filtering and in-page documentation of every anomaly code. Exit 0 on completed analysis, exit 2 on bad usage or an unreadable path.
known_issues: Idle gaps are measured between consecutive events rather than between tool spans, so a quiet stretch covered by an open span still counts as idle.
Span records for the timeline are kept in memory, so memory scales with span count (input lines themselves are streamed).
Exclusive-overlap detection is pairwise within a session, i.e. quadratic in the number of exclusive spans in that session.
